name: Yat Siu
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Animoca Brands tweeted that @ysiu social media account has been compromised. There is no official token or NFT launch from Animoca Brands. The token launch on Solana as claimed in a post was made by the hacker. Please do not engage with the account and stay vigilant.
